title: Limitation prescribed by state tax laws as affected by period of service.
bodyText: Section 657D-16 shall not apply to any period of limitation in state tax laws set forth in title 14.
bodyHtml: [§657D-18]  Limitation prescribed by state tax laws as affected by period of service.  Section 657D-16 shall not apply to any period of limitation in state tax laws set forth in title 14. [L 1994, c 257, pt of §2]
